subject: Renewal pipeline hygiene: Q3 commit verification & risk buckets
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@sean_gallagher@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal pipeline hygiene: Q3 commit verification & risk buckets

Team —

As discussed on yesterday's ops sync, finance needs a cleaned up Q3 renewal commit by EOD Monday so forecasting is ready for the July board packet. I attached a working sheet (q3_renewal_hygiene_slate.xlsx) with the current set of accounts we list as "Commit" / "Best Case" / "At Risk." Please do the following before EOD Monday: 

- Mark each account with a risk bucket: GREEN / YELLOW / RED and add one short reason (30 chars max).
- For any RED accounts, add the specific blocker (procurement, budget, security, product, other) and the next owner for outreach.
- Confirm committed ARR number in the sheet matches HubSpot (link in related_links). Vivek, please flag any accounting gotchas if the ARR number includes prepaid credits.
- If you have an active contract redline, attach or point to it in the grid.

Focus note: Nimbus Health is showing up as a semi-commit in the CRM but we have outstanding SOC2 evidence and an outstanding ELS pricing ask. If we can't move that to GREEN, assume it as a 60% probability for the forecast until we have a signed doc.

I'll do a quick follow-up on Monday morning to capture final commits and roll to finance. Thanks — tight turnaround on this one.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodai.com
(415) 555-0143

Jordan —

I've reviewed my book and updated the spreadsheet with initial risk buckets for the 7 accounts I own. Quick highlights: 

- Nimbus Health: MARKED YELLOW -> moved to RED in a comment because legal is waiting on our SOC2 attestation and they pushed for a 12-month paid case study discount. Outreach owner: Sean. Next step: schedule a technical readout and share SOC2 evidence.
- Acme Health: GREEN -> finance confirmed ARR matches HubSpot. Maria at Acme is ok with our renewal terms, just confirming PO timing (I included her email in the sheet).
- Meridian Labs: YELLOW -> procurement asked for a month extension; likely stays in Brownstein (my flag) until updated POC signoff.

I attached the updated sheet and included links to the HubSpot deals for each row. I'll keep chasing, will flag anything bumped to RED by Monday morning.

—Monica

Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal pipeline hygiene: Q3 commit verification & risk buckets

Thanks — I'm looking at the numbers. A couple of clarifications from finance: 

1) If a customer is flagged as "Commit" but their renewal contains a non-recurring credit (one-time onboarding or marketing credit), we should push the ARR cell to a separate column "commit_recurring_arr" so forecast math isn't overstated. Monica — I see Acme has a $30k TOV credit recorded; please move that to the "non-recurring" column.

2) For Nimbus (DEAL-4821), accounting shows the contract value on HubSpot as $420k ARR but invoicing terms proposed are 6-month prepay. If they request an invoice schedule change, probability math needs a manual note.

I'll add a finance tab to the sheet with a reconciliation column. Also - can someone paste the HubSpot deal link into the related_links so FP&A can validate?

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Finance Operations (Redwood Inference)
vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com

Thanks for the quick updates and the forwarded customer note — useful to have the exact language. Final deliverables / owners: 

- Monica: move Acme's $30k credit to non-recurring ARR column; add PO timing estimate and Maria's email as contact.
- Sean: own Nimbus outreach + SOC2 readout scheduling; update Nimbus row to RED->YELLOW only if SOC2 evidence is shared and pricing ask is resolved.
- Vivek: add finance reconciliation tab and confirm which items should be excluded from recurring ARR for forecast math.
- Jordan: I'll package the cleaned sheet and send to FP&A by Tuesday 12pm PT.

If anyone expects not to meet these asks, flag now. Otherwise I'll close the loop and lock the commit assumptions for the Q3 forecast.

Jordan
